recipes.name: Ranch Flavoured Roasted Chickpeas
instructions: Line a baking tray and preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C)*.
Combine all the ingredients in a bowl.
Transfer to the baking tray, and bake on the centre rack of the oven for 30 to 35 minutes, or until golden**. Mix once halfway.
Remove from oven and let cool. Enjoy on salads, soups, or snack away on them as-is. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * We used top and bottom heating (not fan-assisted/convection). ** Baking for 30 minutes results in chickpeas that are crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside. Bake them for closer to 45 minutes makes them ultra crunchy.
Storage Best if enjoyed immediately. Store at room temperature for up to 1 day. It's best if the jar or container is not completely closed so that the chickpeas can "breathe" and remain crispy.
